With promo code "USAFF50", this AOVOPRO BK520 electric bike drops to $226 at AliExpress, which is $20 less than our mention from a few days ago. The bike has front and rear suspension plus mechanical disc brakes, and it is built for paved streets and bike paths rather than rough trails. Shipping is free from a U.S. warehouse. The promo code expires November 18.  Buy Now at AliExpress

Features
  • 750W motor as listed
  • 48V 5.2Ah battery
  • Top speed of up to 22 mph
  • 7 speed settings
  • Up to 45 miles of range as listed
  • 26" wheels
